experiments.mechanism: unsigned 128-bit sparse keys with bounded local rebalance
experiments.question: Do 128-bit sparse order keys meet deterministic/local mutation and rebalance neutrality through 5,000-page-equivalent pressure?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: moves preserved IDs, pressure inserts stayed locally bounded, explicit rebalance was semantic-root neutral, and the 5,000-page-equivalent tier did not require unrelated identity churn.
experiments.failure_action: Select a chunked/B-tree sequence mechanism inside the frozen order invariants.

experiments.question: Can C# and an independent second-language implementation emit byte-identical DOCSeye deterministic-CBOR vectors?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: every valid cross-language vector was byte-identical and every invalid vector received the same classification.
experiments.failure_action: ARCHITECTURE FALSIFIER if public canonicalization cannot be implemented independently.

experiments.question: Which domain-separated current-state tree provides deterministic root and bounded recomputation?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: the measured domain-separated tree produced the same root across independent construction, VACUUM/reorder/index rebuilds, while local edits touched only bounded hash paths.
experiments.failure_action: Choose the measured fan-out/domain layout; the semantic-root contract remains frozen.

experiments.question: Can an independent writer, using only the public spec, make a valid external commit that the product accepts without identity remint or private repair?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: valid independent move/split/merge/extension commits were accepted without product identity remint/private repair and malformed variants were rejected.
experiments.failure_action: ARCHITECTURE FALSIFIER: specification/conformance model is inadequate.

experiments.mechanism: direct keyed SQLite object access plus bounded Merkle path update
experiments.question: Can local query/edit avoid whole-document materialization at 10, 500, and 5,000 page-equivalent tiers?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: measured local query/edit remained bounded to the targeted records/hash path at all three tiers; latency, amplification, index rebuild, delta size, and memory evidence are recorded without a threshold claim.
experiments.failure_action: Optimize records/indexes; unbounded tier growth reopens storage architecture.

experiments.question: Can a 1 GiB synthetic embedded asset be added/replaced/verified without rewriting or materializing unrelated semantic content?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: the 1 GiB asset path streamed digest/write operations with bounded process memory, preserved figure identity, touched zero unrelated semantic records, and recovered old-or-new across the injected crash.
experiments.failure_action: Change blob/chunk mechanism; asset identity contract remains.

experiments.question: Can total external-state loss rebuild FTS/query indexes and resume bounded deltas without semantic identity change?
experiments.binary_or_bounded_conclusion: PASS: total runtime-index loss rebuilt from DND with exact semantic identity/root; an expired cursor returned explicit resync_required rather than silent delta loss.
experiments.failure_action: Fix runtime protocol; dependency on external truth is an architecture falsifier.
